title: The Complete Shelf
description: Browse nineteen procedural hardcovers on a continuous 3D shelf, then pull any volume forward to orbit, zoom, and inspect its editorial details.

prompt.objective: Build a warm editorial 3D library where people browse a continuous shelf and inspect individual hardcovers.

mintAssets.brief: A cohesive 19-piece library of varied clothbound hardcovers with distinct proportions and abstract foil motifs.

experience: Browse the continuous shelf with drag, wheel, arrow keys, buttons, or position markers.
Pull the selected book forward into a detailed orbit, pan, and zoom inspection view.
prompt.visualDirection: Warm editorial minimalism with cream paper, walnut shelving, serif typography, and muted clothbound covers.

thumbnail.alt: A warm editorial 3D bookshelf with colorful procedural hardcovers arranged above a walnut shelf.

social.title: The Complete Shelf
social.description: Browse nineteen procedural hardcovers and pull any volume forward for close inspection.
